input.final_summary: Dashboard pages follow a fixed stack: friendly URL in urlrewrite.config → aspx (Master + ascx) → ashx JSON API → JS init + DASH_* SQL. StudentSanctionDashboard is the best template; admissions only has a hidden menu cluster and SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB — no dedicated DASH admissions feature yet.

ASPX = Master + register ASCX + CSS/JS content placeholders** ```1:29:g:\0.0.0.Dashboard\cd-21\hisa\Pages\Dashboards\Student\StudentSanctionDashboard.aspx <%@ Page Title="..." MasterPageFile="~/Dashboard.Master" ... %> <%@ Register Src="~/Dashboards/Student/StudentSanctionDashboard.ascx" ... %> CSS JS init ``` **B. Page auth** — session check → redirect login: ```csharp if (Session[DCore.Globals.USER] == null) Response.Redirect("~/dang-nhap.html"); ``` **C. ASCX** — title/breadcrumb, filters (`UYearSemesterFilter` + `UClassFilter`), `window.*FilterConfig`, loading/error/empty states, KPI + ApexCharts containers. Prefix IDs: `ssdDash*`. **D. ASCX code-behind** — load filters on first load: ```csharp uYearSemesterFilter.ShowMonth = false; if (!IsPostBack) { uYearSemesterFilter.LoadData(); uClassFilter.LoadData(); } ``` **E. API (`IHttpHandler`, `IReadOnlySessionState`)** - URL: `/Dashboards/API/StudentSanctionDashboardApi.ashx` - Actions: `action=filters` | `action=data` (default) - Permission: `frmWebStudentList_View` - SPs: `DASH_StudentSanction_GetData` / `DASH_StudentReward_GetData` / `DASH_StudentClassSize_GetFilter` - Filters: `yearId`, `semester`, `scienceId`, `courseId`, `classId`, `fromDate`, `toDate`, `viewType` - Multi-result via `@ResultSet` 1..7 → JSON keys: `summary`, `bySanctionForm`, `byMonth`, `byScience`, `byCourse`, `byViolationType`, `byClass`, `updatedAt` - Response shape: `{ success, message, data }` **F. JS data flow** ```javascript API_URL = "/Dashboards/API/StudentSanctionDashboardApi.ashx" postJson({ action: "filters", listType, scienceId, courseId }, ...) postJson({ action: "data", viewType, yearId, semester, scienceId, courseId, classId, fromDate, toDate }, ...) // → renderDashboard(data) → KPI + ApexCharts ``` - `listType`: 1=Science, 2=Course, 3=Class (cascading multi-select) - Charts: ApexCharts; utils from `dashboard-chart-utils.js` **G. SQL pattern** ```sql CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_StudentSanction_GetData ( @ScienceID nvarchar(1000) = NULL, @CourseID nvarchar(1000) = NULL, @ClassID nvarchar(1000) = NULL, @YearID int, @Semester tinyint, @FromDate datetime = NULL, @ToDate datetime = NULL, @ResultSet tinyint = NULL -- 1..7 single; NULL = all ) ``` Temp view `#tbl*` → filter → branch by `@ResultSet`. --- ## 3.
